{{Quote|Shoota' them up real good!|General Tobler Ceel|<ref name="FC" />}}
'''Tobler Ceel''' was a [[Gungan]] [[Gender|male]] who served as the leader of the [[Gungan Grand Army]] and was the most experienced officer in its [[Officer corps (Gungans)|officer corps]].<ref name="On the Front Lines" /> He fought during the [[Battle of Naboo]] against the [[Trade Federation]] on his [[homeworld]] of [[Naboo]]<ref name="FC" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> He was also a close friend and a former brother-in-arms of [[Boss]] [[Rugor Nass]].<ref name="On the Front Lines" /> Ceel had [[Color|purple]] and white skin as well as yellow [[eye]]s.<ref name="FC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tobler Ceel first appeared in the early drafts of the script for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], but did not make it into the film itself.<ref name="chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=01515#16873740|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2007-08-30|time=2:06 PM|quote=Tobler Ceel has never been confirmed as appearing in The Phantom Menace. The lines from the published script attributed to Ceel are spoken by Captain Tarpals in the film.}}</ref> The character first appeared in [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''.<ref name="FC" />
